locator.name: the tray dock > places the tray over the frame, its bottom edge just above the message box

proves.facet: Pure rectangle placement keeps the dock bottom above the measured composer top and recomputes height from the current frame.

locator.name: the tray dock > keeps today’s frame-wide placement when the plug-in reports no extent

proves.facet: A vertical-only edge keeps the frame-wide left and width, which is the older plug-in's placement.

locator.name: the tray dock > takes the message box’s own left and width, with the frame only as their origin

proves.facet: The width is returned as the box reports it, unclamped: with distinct frame, anchor and box offsets the placement is frame.left + box.left - anchor.left, and the 640 px operand the case passes against a 500 px fixture frame is a deliberate over-width probe, not a measured box.

locator.name: expands when the docked line itself is clicked, away from its button

proves.facet: Pins head expansion and the Close control’s independent action.

locator.name: keeps the close control on the docked line closing the tray, and does not expand on it

proves.facet: Pins head expansion and the Close control’s independent action.

locator.name: the tray dock > sits below the frame with one named notice when the message box cannot be read

proves.facet: Unavailable composer state draws the below-frame tray and the named composer notice.

locator.name: the tray dock > docks over the box’s own column in a layout whose frame is wider than its chat

proves.facet: The rendered dock takes the box's 120px left and 300px width inside a frame that is wider than the chat.

locator.name: the tray dock > bounds the full view to the frame above the message box: its list scrolls, the message field and Send stay

proves.facet: The expanded dock applies the measured max height and keeps the message/Send area outside the scrolling pick list.
